description: Minimal capability for the local shell window. NOTE: this capability deliberately has no `remote` field. Under Tauri v2, remotely-loaded content can only reach the IPC bridge if its origin is listed in a capability's `remote.urls`. Omitting it means the Portal origin has ZERO access to Tauri commands, which is the primary security property of this POC. Do not add a `remote` entry without a specific reviewed reason. The autostart permissions below are here, and NOT in `portal-notifications.json`, precisely because that file is the one that names the remote Portal origin: the 'Start at login' toggle is driven from the Rust tray menu, so the hosted page must never be able to register or remove a login item.
